C9000128.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 128 (A factor-two approximation for shortest common superstring.; papers: A Polynomial-Time 2-Approximation for Shortest Common Superstring; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/128.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

M_MAIN.statement: thm:main: deterministic polynomial-time factor-two approximation for explicitly represented ordinary strings; not maximum-overlap Greedy.

M_COUNTS.statement: lem:counts: m(s) is bounded by the occurrence count of s in every common superstring and W=sum_c m(c)<=OPT.

M_BASE.statement: lem:base: nonnegative edge multiplicities give a balanced hierarchical base graph containing the required strings, with W up edges.

M_RECORDED.statement: lem:recorded: closed-walk recorded-occurrence counts equal m(s), with counts modulo walk turn length.

M_LAYERS.statement: lem:layers: sorting aligned primitive-text passages preserves edges and produces ordered one-period layers; budgets sum to W.

M_MATCHING.statement: lem:matching-window: blocking functional counts blocked records, and unblocked records have actual agreeing layer windows.

M_AGREEMENT.statement: lem:agreement: distinct aligned period-p and period-q texts agree on fewer than p+q positions; equal-period texts on fewer than p.

M_ROTATION.statement: lem:max-rotation: the stated lexicographic maximal-rotation comparison prevents agreement for q positions with the distinct target.

M_WINDOWS.statement: lem:ordered-windows: ordered valid windows admit a directed hierarchical walk of up cost equal to the end increase, visiting length <=max(0,b-c).

M_BAND.statement: lem:band: an ordered same-text band with top-first minus bottom-last <=h, a nonnegative period multiple, can be joined for cost <=h.

M_COLLECTIVE.statement: lem:collective: the three displayed endpoint inequalities give a cost-kp closed link touching k source layers.

M_HOST.statement: lem:host: for a nonempty family of pairwise distinct child text groups agreeing on actual host records and requester windows a_i+p_i<e<=b_i-p_i, the host and all requesters can be rooted within q plus all reserved requester budgets.

M_CHOOSE_K.statement: lem:choose-k and chosen-record construction: count and blocking rules supply a suitable band and actual receiving record.

M_PARTITION.statement: prop:partition: each layer is rooted or in exactly one outgoing block, with disjoint reserved budgets; requests go to larger periods.

M_FREE.statement: lem:free-period: a k-layer period-p block can be internally joined within (k-1)p, freeing one budget p.

M_CYCLE.statement: lem:cycle-contact: a maximal-rotation cycle link can expose a contact of length at most its target period within its budget.

M_CONNECTION.statement: thm:connection: all base components connect to the empty word with added up cost <=W.

M_ALGORITHM.statement: Euler-tour extraction yields a common superstring of length <=2W and all representation, count, sorting, connection, and extraction steps are bit-polynomial.

H_HOST_VERIFIED.statement: Independent universal constructive verification of lem:host under its original hypotheses, not of the entire approximation theorem.

H_CYCLIC.statement: Actual records on a monotone q-periodic host can be normalized and cyclically ordered between a chosen record and its q-translate; transporting each entire child alignment preserves its words and actual windows.

H_CLIPPING.statement: Minimum-period selection and strict agreement bounds make all clipped contacts valid, ordered, attachable, and shorter than p_j on the closing transition.

H_PATHS.statement: Explicit suffix-deletion/prefix-append and gap-letter steps are valid hierarchical-graph paths and have the claimed up cost.

H_ROOTING.statement: Host excursion, child attachment loops, and one short-contact round trip form a connected balanced support containing the empty word and every participating layer, within q plus the reserved budgets.
